ConnectionStrings._comment: In Docker these are overridden by ConnectionStrings__Postgres / ConnectionStrings__Redis (see compose.yaml, values from .env). The localhost defaults below are ONLY for a standalone `dotnet run` against a local Postgres + Redis started via `docker compose up db redis` — they match the dev credentials in .env.example / appsettings.Development.json. They are throwaway local values, never production secrets.

Jwt._comment: Fallback issuer/audience used only when a resolved tenant carries none of its own.

Resend._comment: Outbound email for verification codes. Supply the real ApiKey via the Resend__ApiKey environment variable (RESEND_API_KEY in .env) — never commit it. FromEmail is a verified Resend sender address.

MyPassKeys._comment_DeploymentHosts: Hostnames where THIS MyPassKeys installation is reachable (e.g. 'auth.example.com', 'localhost:5205'). Requests on any other host must match a per-tenant Tenant.Hosts entry or are 404'd. In Docker this is set from DEPLOYMENT_HOST in .env (see compose.yaml). The 'localhost:5205' default here is for a standalone `dotnet run` (Kestrel listens on :5205 — see Properties/launchSettings.json).
MyPassKeys._comment_IssuerBaseUrl: Base for auto-deriving each tenant's immutable JwtIssuer as '{IssuerBaseUrl}/t/{tenantId}'. MUST be an exact string match with the resource server's issuer base. In Docker set from ISSUER_BASE_URL in .env; standalone dev overrides it to http://localhost:5205 in appsettings.Development.json.
MyPassKeys._comment_Bootstrap: On a fresh deployment a management tenant is seeded with these origins/issuer/audience and the user from Tenant:BootstrapOwnerEmail is granted the tenantadmin role in it (re-applied on every startup so the operator can always log back in). After the initial seed these origin/issuer/audience values are NOT re-applied — edit the tenant via PUT /tenants/{id} instead. In Docker BootstrapManagementOrigins[0] is set from BOOTSTRAP_MANAGEMENT_ORIGIN in .env.
MyPassKeys._comment_KeyEncryptionKey: REQUIRED base64 32-byte key that encrypts tenant signing keys at rest. The app refuses to start without one. Never commit a real value here — Docker supplies it via MyPassKeys__KeyEncryptionKey (KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY in .env); standalone dev uses the throwaway value in appsettings.Development.json. Leaving this empty is correct for the committed file.

Tenant._comment: Email guaranteed to hold tenantadmin in the management tenant. Re-applied on every startup so the operator can always log back into the admin portal. In Docker set from BOOTSTRAP_OWNER_EMAIL in .env.

ForwardedHeaders._comment: Trust only these proxies to set X-Forwarded-*. Defaults to loopback when both lists are empty. In Docker the reverse-proxy/bridge CIDRs are added via ForwardedHeaders__KnownNetworks__* (see compose.prod.yaml). For Cloudflare-fronted setups, add Cloudflare's published IP ranges.
